direction_benchmark.rationale: With no independent unconditional Gold-window control dataset in the current repository, production direction quality uses a predeclared balanced-sign null plus minimum bullish/bearish coverage. This avoids letting a one-sided Gold drift masquerade as symmetric skill. A richer unconditional benchmark may only be introduced in a new qualification-policy version/cohort.

edge_benchmark.rationale: ACTIONABLE_EDGE must outperform the system’s own low/no-edge episodes.

permission_benchmark.rationale: Permission is judged on path support/opposition rather than PnL.

wait_benchmark.rationale: WAIT quality is judged as restraint value rather than price-direction prediction.
